notes:
Account overview: PrismForge Labs is a mid-market product analytics SaaS targeting product/eng teams. Currently using OpenAI for embeddings + chat; exploring Redwood to reduce per-token costs and get deterministic latency under load. They want to pilot on Hosted API then move to Dedicated for predictable throughput and stronger isolation.

Key stakeholders: CTO - Neha Reddy (technical lead), Head of ML - Aaron Liu, VP Product - Claire Donovan. Purchasing: procurement + legal involved for residency and contract terms.

POC summary: Hosted API POC started 2026-02-15. Scope: support chat (customer-facing), embeddings for search, reranking on top of candidate lists. Baseline run against current vendor (OpenAI): prompt parity harness executed across ~120 core prompts and 30 long-form dialogues.

Findings to date:
- Latency: Redwood hosted median token latency comparable to baseline; 95th pctl under 250ms for short dialogs, spikes observed for long-context (>2k tokens) generation during our synthetic load test.
- Cost: projected cost savings 20-35% depending on batching/caching strategies; biggest delta when KV caching reduces repeated context.
- Quality: prompt-parity failures on ~8% of edge prompts (mainly formatting/regression on list enumerations). Team flagged 6 representative cases to reproduce.
- Compatibility: Redwood's compatibility layer largely works but requires adapting a small set of tool-calling hooks and stop-sequence behavior.

Timeline / recent activity (bulleted):
- 2026-02-15: Hosted API POC kickoff (goals, test harness share).
- 2026-02-18: Demo w/ engineering — live walkthrough of prompt parity harness (FF-2026-02-18-8342).
- 2026-02-24: SE introduced compatibility shim to map OpenAI parameters to Redwood equivalents; early fix reduced formatting regressions.
- 2026-03-02: Deep-dive on long-context performance with runtime team; identified kernel selection mismatch for particular model variant (FF-2026-03-02-9011).
- 2026-03-05: Pricing worksheet v2 shared to drive (drive://prismforge/Redwood_pricing_deck_v2.pdf); finance requested 3-year committed scenario.
- 2026-03-08: Legal submitted initial questions on data residency and audit logs.

Quotes / call notes: "We need to be sure there are no surprise regressions when we flip traffic — our user flows are unforgiving." — Aaron Liu (Head of ML).
"If Redwood can show parity on our 120 prompt set and a solid Dedicated sizing plan, we can accelerate procurement." — Claire Donovan (VP Product).

Migration plan (high-level):
- Phase 1: Finish Hosted POC and close prompt parity/regression items (today + 2 weeks).
- Phase 2: Pilot production traffic on Hosted for non-critical workloads (1 month), instrument cost/latency dashboards.
- Phase 3: Dedicated sizing review and contract (months 2-3), test migration of model pins and rollout policies.
- Phase 4: Cutover with canary, A/B and automatic fallback to Hosted if regressions surface.

Open technical risks & mitigation:
- Prompt parity regressions: SE to patch compatibility shim and add paraphrase-tolerant evals; run nightly regression harness.
- Long-context latency spikes: Redwood infra to propose kernel selection + quantization profile; run stress test w/ KV caching enabled.
- Tool-calling differences: map existing tool-call hooks and add unit tests for function outputs.

Procurement / commercial notes: Pricing asks: committed Dedicated discount tiers, token pricing breakdown, cost model for embeddings vs chat, chargeback-ready billing exports. They asked for a draft MSA and EU data residency addendum.

Next steps (explicit):
- SE (Daniel Park) to run second pass of parity harness with compatibility shim applied by 2026-03-14.
- Host a Dedicated sizing call w/ infra + ops on 2026-03-18 (requested by PrismForge).
- Send updated 3-year committed pricing scenario by 2026-03-12 (owner: Sofia).
- Legal to receive draft MSA + residency addendum by 2026-03-15.

Short-term ask from account: "Close parity on the 6 flagged regressions, provide clear Dedicated latency SLOs, and produce a 3-year committed pricing scenario for finance."
